about: The first demonstration, as a person does it in the application, one step per action. Each step names the gates of docs/product-direction.md it serves, the results that must be observable after it, and the owner area a failure routes to. scripts/rehearsal/rehearse.py runs it; tests/test_rehearsal_steps.py holds it to the gates that document states.

gate_sources.heading: Delivery gates for the first demonstration

spend.budget_split_reason: This rehearsal's hosted allowance is $0.15 in total. The API has $0.12 so a town comparison can hold a $0.05 bound after earlier asks; the derivative worker has a separate $0.03 ceiling for photograph work. The two process ceilings sum to the total allowance, so even simultaneous calls cannot overspend it.
spend.max_calls_reason: A living-town comparison asks once for each model-decided person, run and simulated minute (exulanica/world/society_comparison.py), and this rehearsal also asks models for photographs, answers and drafted town values. Each of the API and derivative-worker processes receives a 7000-call ceiling; their aggregate call ceiling is 14000 and their separate USD ceilings remain authoritative.
spend.reason: Hosted model calls are made only by the steps marked hosted_model, through the product's configured client and its policy boundary. A run stops starting them once the spend the product reports reaches bound_usd, and a step list whose estimates add up to more than ask_before_usd is not well formed, because that run needs a decision first.

unserved_gates.milestone:Honest difference: The rehearsal's comparison runs on one development seed, which is never judged: a verdict bounding a difference between models by its same-model control pair is given only on held-out seeds, which a rehearsal does not spend.

gates_in_part.milestone:A world to run: the market town and the drafted town are made from the catalogs and opened; the town's people are seen moving by the society's reads and drawn, and their walking pace is sampled only in the starter's square.
gates_in_part.milestone:A model per group: one group of the starter's people and one of the town's are each decided by one open model and the others by their routine; the people are not split into several named groups each under its own model, and a refused proposal is seen only when the model makes one.
gates_in_part.milestone:Swap and compare: the comparison swaps one group's model for one simulated hour of the town on one development seed, not the town's day.
gates_in_part.delivery:Usable world: the town's people are watched moving by the society's reads and drawn, and vehicles by the traffic reads; the separate diagnosis of world, simulation and rendering failures is by each step's owner area.
gates_in_part.delivery:Models in their roles: one group's decisions come from its named model and the others' from their routine, in the starter and in the town; a refused proposal is seen only when the model makes one.
gates_in_part.delivery:Swap and compare: the swapped pair and its same-model control run one simulated hour of the town on one development seed.
gates_in_part.delivery:Persistence and replay: the saved world is reopened and holds what was saved, the living society and the comparison's runs replay from their stored decisions without calling a model, and the comparison leaves the saved town unchanged; the runs are one simulated hour of the town, not its day.

human-review.statement: The human review of the rehearsal's photographs is given by the rehearsal driver, through the photo drawer's own controls, under the run's synthetic account. The photographs are synthetic drawings with no people in them. This review stands in for a person's review; it is not one, and no person inspected these photographs.

human-review.purpose: Rehearsal of the first demonstration on synthetic drawings; the review is the rehearsal driver's stand-in for a person's review
human-review.authority_basis: Synthetic drawings made by the rehearsal; no personal photograph, and no person reviewed them
human-review.gate_qualification: Passed on a review the rehearsal driver gave in place of a person; it is not a person's review.

derivative_worker.reason: The API's own worker runs no depth model (exulanica/api/services.py build_derivative_worker), so a photograph it finishes stays without a point map. The worker main runs in production (exulanica/ingest/worker_command.py) runs the depth stage when EXULANICA_DEPTH_MODEL is moge, with the checkpoint models.manifest.json pins, on the device docs/scene-reconstruction-operations.md section 7 gives a local checkout. HF_HUB_OFFLINE keeps it to the checkpoint already on this machine: a run downloads nothing.

tile_worker.reason: The acceptance launcher owns one production generated-tile worker for its synthetic workspace. It checks startup, records the process, and stops it with the stack. The town step matches its baked events to the saved town's tiles, so a process merely starting cannot pass.

society_playback.reason: The living session presses Play in People nearby and watches the host advance the world on its own. The acceptance launcher's --society-playback makes the API play the run's own workspace at the host's declared base wait, the pace the product ships (docs/evaluation/2026-09-24-living-world-pace.json), and refuses to start unless readiness reports that workspace played; without it People nearby offers no Play.

answer_deadlines.reason: The page first asks POST /selection/appearance whether an utterance is a change, then asks POST /selection/ask; it waits for each as long as these constants say. The driver waits for a reply as long as the page it drives does, read from the application tree the run builds.
